episodes.title: Why are people attracted to abusive cult leaders and false gurus?
episodes.description:
QUESTION: Yes unfortunately I didn't have much discernment in my 20's and then I was suckered in and brainwashed, 'reality testing' was seen as a lack of faith. But I continue, stronger and building back better. It's unfortunate my fellow ex practitioners in Falun Gong are so burnt by decades in the cult they then abandon being on the path, everything spiritual is then seen through the lens of suspicion and the baby is thrown out with the bath water. The so called 'Master' in Falun Gong Li Hongzhi is just a con man, on the level with Hubbard in Scientology. He isn't even comparably to figures like Osho or Sai Baba who you could argue had some level of spirituality and then got lost, fell whatever. 

It's hard to imagine the psychology of these cult 'Masters' and how they dedicate a lifetime to weaving this deception to fleece people. Well meaning seekers get caught in this, many will go to their deaths believing in this con man and how he will be offering them the ultimate deliverance. I feel fortunate to have got out. I don't know if you have any opinion why these fake cults can exist? 

Especially considering that many of the people who join these cults have a genuine desire for spiritual improvement. It seems terribly 'unfair' considering these people have a genuine desire to connect to the Divine. What then are they connecting to in these cults - a divine force of sorts (many of my fellow ex practitioners have supernormal experiences, third eye visions etc) or is it some occult mumbo jumbo which is actually dangerous? 

And why don't any of the ascended Masters help these victims of cults?
